Kabul: Academy of Sciences of Afghanistan, Centre for Social Sciences (Institute of History). 273 pp. scan; ACKU digitisation doi:10.2458/azu_acku_ds324_s5_seen95_1386; archive.org item mardom-shenasi-sistan-persianbooks-1.
sources.note: States (scanned, p. 81) that the chief phonetic characteristic of the natives' dialect is pronouncing verbs 'به سکون اول' (with a vowelless first consonant, i.e. initial clusters) and many words 'به دو سکون' (with two-consonant clusters), unlike Dari; gives Sistani verb paradigms (raft-/xord- past, present with mē-), notes absence of a distinct future and the b- imperative prefix, then a glossary with vowel indications. No mention of تکیه/stress, accent or tone in the scanned pages (80-95).
